The '''Devil's Asteroid system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> containing<ref name="Fry">{{PlanetSystemNames}}</ref> the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] known as [[Devil's Asteroid]].<ref name="Monsters" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Devil's Asteroid system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square O-2.<ref name="TEA" />
